changeSet.author: nelson
changeSet.comment: Set a lone undisbursed tranche to remaining approved principal when it was left at the applied amount
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan_disbursement_detail dd INNER JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = dd.loan_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT loan_id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail WHERE actual_disbursement_date IS NULL GROUP BY loan_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) single_open ON single_open.loan_id = dd.loan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT loan_id, COALESCE(SUM(principal), 0) AS disbursed_principal FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail WHERE actual_disbursement_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loan_id ) paid ON paid.loan_id = dd.loan_id SET dd.principal = GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(paid.disbursed_principal, 0), 0), dd.net_disbursal_amount = GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(paid.disbursed_principal, 0), 0) WHERE dd.actual_disbursement_date IS NULL AND l.approved_principal IS NOT NULL AND l.loan_status_id IN (200, 300) AND dd.principal IS NOT NULL AND dd.principal <> GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(paid.disbursed_principal, 0), 0)
